chunks: And from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The believer is the brother of the believer in terms of father and mother, because Allah (Glorified is His Majesty) created the believers from the earth of Paradise and brought about their forms from the breeze of Paradise, for that reason they are full brothers.

key_terms.أَبِيهِ وَأُمِّهِ: his father and mother (indicating full siblinghood)

ai.seo_question: Why are believers considered full brothers in Shia theology?
ai.summary: Abu Ja'far (a.s.) elucidates that believers are 'brothers by father and mother' due to their shared spiritual origin, having been fashioned from the essence of Paradise (Jinan). This metaphysical kinship, rooted in the 'clay of gardens' and the 'breeze of gardens,' transcends biological ties to establish an intrinsic, divine bond of unity among the faithful.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 88. It has been reported that Abu Ja'far (a.s) said:

Believers are full brothers. That is because Allah [M.G] created the believers from the earth of Paradise and brought about their forms from the breeze of Paradise. For that reason, they are full brothers.
